system.description:
Acquired with CR11 or higher. You may make a [Normal Move] up to your [Speed] Sq. During this Main Process, you gain a +[SRx[DEX mod]] bonus to [Weapon Attack] damage rolls.

(Minor): Increase the distance moved by +1 Sq.

A skill that provides a run-up for subsequent attacks. The momentum from sprinting is directly converted into striking power. Storm across the battlefield, your blade weaving constant death.
